title: Matrix inequality conjecture for zero diagonal entries
statement:
Let $M$ be a matrix with non-negative real entries, let $t$ be an odd positive integer, and let $(x_1,y_1),\ldots,(x_t,y_t)$ be distinct entries of $M$ satisfying $M_{x_i y_i}=0$ for every $i=1,\ldots,t$. **Matrix inequality conjecture.** Then

$$
\sum_{i=1}^{t}\sum_{j=1}^{t}M_{x_i y_j}M_{x_j y_i}\leqslant (t-1)\lVert M\rVert_{\infty}\lVert M\rVert_{1}.
$$

The paper formulates this inequality because it implies the weak balls conjecture and proves it in a special case; its general validity remains open.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.18253

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of March 2026).
source_name: Ilya I. Bogdanov, Fedor Petrov, Anton Sadovnichiy and Fedor Ushakov, “Biregular bipartite labeled multigraphs and perfect matchings in bipartite tensor products”, arXiv:2603.18253 (2026).
